"""Synthetic constructor-caller metadata fixture; never historical execution."""
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import pytest
from talkcut.project import artifact_ref, atomic_json
native = SimpleNamespace(ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2], ref=artifact_ref, save=atomic_json)

def launch_fixture(tmp_path):
    from talkcut.contracts import code_identity, freeze_contract

    source = tmp_path / "source.bin"
    source.write_bytes(b"authored source fixture")
    audio = tmp_path / "audio.wav"
    audio.write_bytes(b"not played; binding-only fixture")
    contract = tmp_path / "contract.json"
    freeze_contract(native.ROOT, contract)
    value = {
        "schema_version": "private-native-audio-launch/v1",
        "purpose": "binding test only",
        "audio": native.ref(audio),
        "source_artifacts": {"screen": native.ref(source)},
        "contract": native.ref(contract),
        "dependencies": {
            "source_hashes": {"screen": native.ref(source)["sha256"]},
            "contract_hash": native.ref(contract)["sha256"],
            "code_tree_hash": code_identity(native.ROOT)["code_tree_hash"],
        },
    }
    launch = tmp_path / "launch.json"
    native.save(launch, value)
    return launch, value

@pytest.mark.parametrize("changed", [False, True])
def test_actual_tiny_child_transport_case_and_summary_binding(tmp_path, changed):
    launch, value = launch_fixture(tmp_path)
    assert value["contract"]["path"] == str(launch.parent / "contract.json")
